scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm --workspace apps/api run dev" "npm --workspace apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace packages/core run build && npm --workspace apps/api run build && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace packages/core run test && npm --workspace packages/ocr-eval run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace packages/core run typecheck && npm --workspace packages/ocr-eval run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/api run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/web run typecheck
